title: Plugins
description: Plugins installed on this instance, and what each of them loaded.

official.label: Official
official.tooltip: Maintained or approved by Attraccess. This label does not mean the plugin is sandboxed or guaranteed safe.

community.label: Community
community.tooltip: Not on Attraccess's approved package-source allowlist. Review the source and requested permissions before installing.

marketplace.title: Plugin marketplace
marketplace.description: Find compatible plugins from configured package registries.
marketplace.installDescription: Review the package source and requested permissions before installing. The app will restart to activate the plugin.
marketplace.installSuccess: Plugin installed. The app will restart in a few seconds to activate it.
marketplace.installError: The plugin was not installed. Please try again.

status.errorTooltip: This plugin failed to load on the server: {{message}}

aside.title: Writing a plugin
aside.description: Plugins extend the API and the frontend from a single bundle. The developer guide covers the manifest, the permission model and local development.

deleteConfirmation.title: Remove plugin?
deleteConfirmation.message: Remove the plugin {{pluginName}}? This cannot be undone, and the app will reload once it is gone.

versions.title: Could not load versions
versions.description: The installed package was not changed. Please try again.

replace.title: Could not replace the plugin
replace.description: The current version is still active. Please try again.

delete.title: Could not remove the plugin
delete.description: The plugin is still installed. Please try again.

replace.title: Plugin version replaced
replace.description: The app will restart in a few seconds to activate the selected version.

delete.title: Plugin removed
delete.description: The app will reload in a few seconds to drop the plugin's code.

versionManagement.title: Manage {{pluginName}} version
versionManagement.downgradeWarning: Downgrading can affect plugin data and requires an application restart.
